_about: Hand-written logic layer (work-order step 3), applied on top of region_graph_auto.json by logic_check.py. Requirement expressions: item:N, event:NAME, reach:F/R (or a virtual node), &, |, parentheses, true, never. status: verified = from scripts/data (evidence given), rule = agreed with the user (RandomizerPlan.md section 2), assumption = NOT verified, to confirm in play.

1/1W.evidence: 3rd-floor corridor hole (LIFE 38, OBJ 31; scene zone F1:R1:SZ3, x 1300..1800 across the corridor's full width) kills the player, and jumping is not available there (user, 2026-10-28). It splits F1:R1: node 1/1 = the attic side (Storage Closet, Study, Dressing Room doors), 1/1W = the stairwell side (Master Bedroom, Master Bathroom, Stairwell doors). The only way between them is Dressing Room <-> Master Bedroom (no door). Found by Generated/Logic/audit/room_walk.py and confirmed by the user (Research/LogicAudit_2026-10-27.md).

enemy_drop_slots._about: Optional enemy-drop slots (option 'enemies can drop items'; user 2026-10-15, Research/EnemyDrops_Review.md). A rolled enemy carries 1-2 items, put at its position just before it deletes itself at death (`put_at ITEM ENEMY` before every `delete ENEMY` in its own scripts). requires = spawn condition + kill requirement; combat is always possible (user).
